build_paella_vq_model: build a PaellaVQModel instance with custom embed_dim and num_vq_embeddings parameters
encode_image_latents: encode an input image tensor into latent representations using PaellaVQModel.encode
decode_latents_to_image: decode latent tensors back to images using PaellaVQModel.decode with optional quantization
run_vqvae_forward_pass: run a full encode-decode forward pass through PaellaVQModel on an input sample tensor
review_mixing_residual_block: review the MixingResidualBlock class for its depthwise and channelwise mixing with gamma modulations
